scientific_integrity: The infinite theorem is supported by a complete symbolic proof; standalone finite exhaustive and randomized checks corroborate but are not substituted for proof. Priority is a best-knowledge comparison, not a certification.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary two-distance named-color counting on finite simple connected graphs only; not list-color counting or higher powers. General core-square chromatic polynomials may remain hard to compute; historical priority unconfirmed and independent validation absent.
title: Bridge factorization of chromatic polynomials of graph squares
